AC amendment: Add acceptance criterion — 'No tmpfiles leaked after _validate_findings_schema() returns on any exit path (pass/schema_fail/validator_error)'. Verify: python3 -c "import tempfile, os; tmpd = tempfile.mkdtemp(); print('Before:', os.listdir(tmpd)); # After calling _validate_findings_schema with a mocked subprocess, tmpd should contain no .json files"
Practical test: ensure the try/finally block in _validate_findings_schema() calls os.unlink(tmp_path) in all branches including validator_error. Verify: grep -A 30 'def _validate_findings_schema' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py | grep -q 'finally\|os.unlink'
